jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Dev Environments
jobs.description: The Dev Environments team sits within DoorDash's Foundations group (Platform Engineering). We own the local and remote developer experience across the DoorDash group of companies supporting over 5000 engineers. Our mission is to enable engineering velocity, quality, and efficiency at significant scale by removing friction from the day-to-day developer loop: spinning up a working environment, getting code building, and getting feedback fast, whether the "developer" is a human or an AI agent. As a Staff Engineer on Dev Environments, you'll be recognised as an expert across the dev environments space, covering both local and remote dev flows, devcontainers, IDE/remote backends, and how they all fit together, including owning accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams. You'll set technical direction for the team's roadmap, unblock deep cross-cutting technical problems other engineers can't resolve alone, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership across the group to translate ambiguous, company-wide developer-experience problems into a concrete, sequenced technical strategy. What You’ll Be Doing Technical direction Define the architecture for how thousands of engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo actually develop and ship code: local and remote dev containers, remote IDE/VM lifecycle, and the full local-to-remote loop. Build monorepo dev tooling at scale. It's part of consolidating all the companies under DoorDash’s umbrella onto one global backend - you're setting the standard, not patching one org's tooling. Provision production-shaped environments in seconds, keep state in sync over the network, and make a remote machine feel local, reliably and cheaply, at thousands-of-concurrent-engineers scale. Expect to invent as much as you adopt: much of this is genuinely unsolved elsewhere in the industry. Design for AI agents as first-class consumers of the environment, not an afterthought: sandboxes that spin up on demand, run in parallel, and are safe to hand a real repo. Support agents launched from an IDE, a CLI, or a Slack message - with no laptop required to review and ship what the agent did. Collaboration & leadership Align teams that don't naturally sit adjacent to each other (e.g. Security, Infrastructure, Product Engineering) around unstructured, ambiguous problems where there's no existing playbook. Mentor engineers at all levels: run design reviews; raise the engineering bar through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance when appropriate. Help set the hiring bar: lead interview loops, help calibrate, and support onboarding of senior hires. What You’ll Need to Thrive Essential: A track record of shipping production systems and leading cross-team initiatives with group level impact - comfortable owning delivery end to end, from design through to production and adoption. Hands on fluency with the languages and tooling used to build developer tooling (e.g. Go, Python, TypeScript) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). Experience managing compute via Kubernetes (multi-tenant workload isolation, autoscaling ephemeral workloads, cost management), or lightweight VM/sandbox technology (e.g. Firecracker). Working knowledge of cloud networking, including securely and cost-effectively routing traffic across network boundaries (VPNs, service meshes, etc.) Experience integrating LLM/AI tooling into developer workflows - e.g. Claude Code - both locally, and remotely. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence senior stakeholders and align multiple non-adjacent teams without formal authority over them. Experience building close working relationships with the engineering teams who consume your platform, not just the platform team itself. Nice to have: Experience in developer platforms or adjacent infrastructure: devcontainers, remote development, remote IDE backends, or developer workstation tooling. Practical experience with JetBrains remote-backend flows, Codespaces/Codeserver-style products, or equivalent. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. What You'll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?” Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace. London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale : work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast : ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership : take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders : high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create : competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information. jobs.title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description: About the Role Hybrid (3 days per week in the London office required) Team Leadership role The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace. You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment. You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale. What You’ll Be Doing Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned. Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest. Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls. Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments. Owning Performance and Risk Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails. Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost. Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions. Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken. Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys. Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place. Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions. Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails. Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention. Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams. Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line. Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension. Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus. Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact. Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals. Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members. Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction. Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks. Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs. Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions. Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working. Requirements We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring: Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years. Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers. Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects. A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon. Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences. Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance. Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions. Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions. Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations. Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities. You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities. You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today. Why Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas. Workplace & Benefits At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information. Diversity At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.description: This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. jobs.description: Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding The Team The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours). The Problem Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. jobs.description: <h2> </h2> <h1>Company overview</h1> <p>AlixPartners is a leading global business advisory firm of results-oriented professionals who specialise in creating value and restoring performance at every stage of the business life cycle. We thrive on our ability to make a difference in high-impact situations and deliver sustainable bottom-line results.</p> <h1>Job summary</h1> <p>AlixPartners is seeking an experienced EMEA Temporary Service Providers (TSPs) Manager, as a Senior Vice President. This role sits within the People team in the Strategic Resource Management team. to join its Global People team. This role offers an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional with deep expertise in third-party service provider management, employment law compliance and commercial acumen to lead our TSP operations across the EMEA region.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of the TSP office based in the US you will be responsible for managing all aspects of third-party service provider (TSP) operations, including contractor onboarding, contract management, compliance, vendor relations and cost optimisation. You will work closely with our Client-facing Business leaders, Legal, Procurement, Strategic Finance and Analysis, Compliance, Data Privacy, and operational teams across EMEA. You will demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, pragmatic problem-solving capabilities, strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance compliance requirements with business needs whilst managing complex, competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.</p> <h1>Key responsibilities and accountabilities</h1> <h2>Day-to-day TSP management</h2> <ul> <li>Respond to and process TSP requests from the business, liaising with business teams on discrepancies and missing information, and challenging business answers where appropriate to ensure compliance and quality standards.</li> <li>Send TSP questionnaires, review responses for anomalies and completeness, and liaise with Compliance on risk flags (e.g., use of subcontractors, litigation history). Coordinate with Data Privacy teams where personal data processing is involved.</li> <li>Provide preliminary legal and commercial advice on deemed employment risk across multiple locations; escalate complex matters to internal Legal counsel as required.</li> <li>Identify and route contracts to Procurement where appropriate (e.g., vendor agreements, large companies, contractor-paper terms).</li> <li>Obtain necessary approvals on all TSP engagements in line with delegated authorities.</li> <li>Manage the background checks co-ordinating with the applicable Country People Operations team, as required, escalating and solving any flags.</li> <li>Draft Non-Disclosure Agreements and contracts from templates for new TSPs; conduct simple legal and commercial negotiations of TSP agreements.</li> <li>Arrange contract execution and maintain secure, organised records of all signed agreements on our contract management system (Ironclad).</li> <li>Set up TSPs on Oracle for time recording and administrative purposes as required.</li> <li>Ensure all TSPs receive a complete onboarding pack, including compliance policies, procedures, time recording and invoicing guidance.</li> <li>Draft contract amendments, extensions and Statements of Work for existing MSAs and Independent Contractors.</li> <li>Track bill rates, pay rates, cost markups and approvals; manage non-standard markup approvals and Oracle entries.</li> <li>Resolve invoicing and expense queries, respond to core training enquiries, and manage payment processing.</li> <li>Liaise with IT on systems, equipment and access requirements for TSPs.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external staffing partners (e.g., Danbro) and all independent contractors.</li> <li>Track start and expiry dates for Senior Advisors; schedule renewal discussions, record contract terms and maintain signed agreements.</li> <li>Coordinate and share firm-wide Chapter 11 bankruptcy lists on a monthly basis.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Strategic initiatives and ongoing projects</h2> <ul> <li>Lead firm-wide initiatives to optimise our external workforce strategy.</li> <li>Drive implementation of firm-wide measures to mitigate compliance and operational risk associated with TSP usage.</li> <li>Systematise and standardise decision-making on TSP risk levels based on factors such as prior working history, nature of tasks, engagement terms and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to develop an automated risk assessment tool where possible.</li> <li>Contribute to cross-functional People team projects and firm-wide initiatives as required.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>Background, qualifications and personal competencies</h1> <h2>Essential skills and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Process-driven mindset with strong organisational and record-keeping discipline.</li> <li>Pragmatic and solutions-focused with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.</li> <li>Assertive, confident communicator who works collaboratively and proactively identifies when issues require escalation to Legal or People stakeholders.</li> <li>Exceptional ability to prioritise, manage competing demands and maintain all core competencies under time pressure and competing deadlines.</li> <li>Professional background in legal, paralegal or procurement functions, ideally within professional services.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand and assimilate legal language and documentation.</li> <li>Capability to make straightforward legal and commercial amendments to contracts and identify knock-on effects across related clauses.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of EMEA employment law across multiple jurisdictions; demonstrable expertise in contractor classification and compliance.</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills with vendors and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Fluency in another European language, German is preferred.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Personal qualities</h2> <ul> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, matrix-structured organisation and respond positively under pressure.</li> <li>High degree of professionalism when interfacing with colleagues, partners and external stakeholders across multiple regions.</li> <li>Proactive, strategic mindset with the ability to exercise sound judgement and work with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive, commercially sensitive information.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capability.</li> <li>Well-developed risk management and continuous improvement mindset.</li> <li>Strong IT literacy, including Microsoft Office and contract management systems. Familiarity with HR and finance systems desirable.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>In addition to a positive and collaborative workplace, AlixPartners offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.</p> <p>AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>#LI-AP2</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><em>#</em><em>LI-Hybrid</em></span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><em>#LI-AP2</em></span></p> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Manufacturing & Operations - Management Consultant
jobs.description: <p>At AlixPartners we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. We prize diversity and inclusion, the intellectually curious, the inventive, and the forward‑thinking.</p> <p>What sets us apart is a culture that enables each professional to shape their own development path: career progression is not governed by rigid cycles, but by individual growth, readiness, and ambition. You will find a collaborative environment where long‑term development, mentorship, and flexibility are integral to how we work. We invite you to influence the way we operate and contribute to the way we embrace tomorrow.</p> <p>The Manufacturing & Operations practice is growing rapidly, offering you the opportunity to make a tangible impact on clients’ performance. Our work goes beyond slide decks: we partner directly with leadership and frontline teams to design and implement solutions that deliver measurable results. From optimizing production footprints to improving supply chain resilience and driving procurement savings, we focus on execution as much as strategy. You will experience the intensity of real change programs—where decisions are made quickly, and outcomes are visible in operational KPIs and financial performance.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>As a Management Consultant in Manufacturing & Operations, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct operational diagnoses from site visits and data-analysis</li> <li>Define actionable improvement plans working side‑by‑side with client teams on the shop floor and in the boardroom</li> <li>Build models to quantify benefits and track value realization</li> <li>Support implementation and set governance structures that ensure rapid decision‑making and accountability</li> <li>Prepare executive‑level communications that turn complex analysis into clear, pragmatic recommendations</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll need</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Four to eight years</strong> of experience, ideally a mix of consulting and industry within manufacturing/operations.</li> <li>Proven exposure to one or more of: <strong>manufacturing performance improvement (OEE, yield, throughput), footprint optimization (MFO/DFO), supply chain & logistics, sourcing & procurement, working‑capital</strong>, and <strong>digital operations/analytics</strong>.</li> <li>MBA or Master’s degree with a strong academic track record. Degrees in Engineering, Business, Operations, or Finance are preferred.</li> <li>Excellent analytical and modelling skills (operations and 3‑statement/CF as needed) and a track record of delivering high‑value client work.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills: ability to define roles, manage expectations, and execute within cross‑functional teams at plant and corporate levels.</li> <li>Advanced <strong>Excel</strong> and <strong>PowerPoint</strong> fluency.</li> <li>Ability to work both collaboratively and independently; flexible, adaptable, and energized by fast‑moving environments—often on‑site at plants.</li> <li><strong>Fluency in English and Italian</strong>; additional languages are a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel and to work outside standard business hours when projects demand.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a <strong>hybrid model</strong> (office + remote).</li> <li>Alignment with our <strong>Core Values</strong> as in the AlixPartners Code of Conduct, and a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment.</li> </ul> <p><em>The salary range for this role takes into account a number of factors and is between EUR 45,000/year – EUR 65,000/year gross. Bonus opportunity linked to key performance indicators ranging from EUR 1,000/year – EUR 2,000/year gross.  I<span style="text-decoration: underline;">n addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus</span>. Employment terms and benefits are governed in accordance with the applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL).  </em></p> <p><em>In addition to a positive workplace, the firm offers a comprehensive compensation package including an excellent benefit program.</em></p> <p><em>The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.</em></p> <p><em>AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. You will undertake research for and write expert reports of the highest standard for major legal cases or investigations and solve complex business and policy challenges.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Vice President, you will lead the application of behavioural economics and behavioural science across client engagements, partnering with senior stakeholders to translate research, analysis and evidence into actionable strategies that deliver meaningful impact. jobs.title: Turnaround & Restructuring - Vice President
jobs.description: <p>At AlixPartners we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.</p> <p>AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration.  Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working.  Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.</p> <p>We are in an increasingly busy restructuring market and our Turnaround & Restructuring Services practice has ambitious growth plans - this has created opportunities for individuals from a range of backgrounds. Composed of the most respected financial restructuring professionals in the industry, AlixPartners is widely recognised for its long and successful record in helping its clients resolve urgent situations and implement rapid change. We have deep expertise across the entire turnaround lifecycle, with our three main service offerings being:</p> <p>Company Advisory & Interim Management: Working closely with management teams to quickly stabilise crisis situations, protect their position and that of other investors, and deliver optimal outcomes. Our hands-on approach addresses challenges quickly - allowing us to turn around companies who are facing financial and operational challenges through a range of levers that support short-term and long-term ambitions and outcomes for organisations. </p> <p>Creditor Advisory: We rapidly assess situations, working closely with creditors and the management teams of their borrowers to review performance and develop strategies to protect creditors’ positions and deliver optimal outcomes in the most stressed and distressed situations. We have a breadth of knowledge dealing with cash, liquidity, strategy, refinancing and negotiation situations, getting to solutions fast, and implementing solutions through experience.</p> <p>Contingency Planning & Insolvency: We work closely with clients to preserve value by implementing solutions using formal UK and international restructuring tools and most importantly, our practical expertise. We excel in complex distressed situations, often involving multiple jurisdictions and diverse stakeholder groups.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>We now have opportunities in London for VPs who have experience working for clients in one of more of the above areas. Whilst we expect our VPs to contribute to projects in each of the above areas, it is possible to specialise as your career progresses.</p> <p>We are looking for smart, pragmatic and results-focused individuals, who can operate on a range of UK based as well as international engagements. We are keen to attract people who can contribute to AlixPartners’ enviable reputation for driving positive change for the immediate and long-term success of our clients. VPs are involved in a range of engagements supporting the project team in dealing with clients in a ‘hands-on’, professional and energetic manner. They collaborate with colleagues across the world as well as engage with, and promote, the firm’s broader capabilities. </p> <p><strong>What you’ll need </strong></p> <p><strong>Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:</strong></p> <ul> <ul> <li> <div>Ideally between 3-7 years’ experience in a similar role or environment.*</div> Relevant and hands-on project management experience in restructuring gained in restructuring advisory, consulting, private equity, banking or industry.</li> <li>University degree or relevant school-leaver-programme experience, ideally as well as a post graduate qualification (eg. ACA/ACCA)</li> <li>Demonstrable experience in some of the following situations is essential:</li> <li>Financial turnaround programmes</li> <li>Cash and working capital management</li> <li>Building, reviewing and maintaining short term cash flow models</li> <li>Formulating, reviewing and analysing business plans and financial forecasts</li> <li>Supporting Chief Restructuring Officer roles</li> <li>Balance sheet restructurings</li> <li>Options analysis</li> <li>Contingency planning</li> <li>Schemes of Arrangements / Restructuring Plans</li> <li>Trading Administrations</li> <li>Insolvency case management and progression</li> <li>Independent business reviews</li> <li>Distressed sales</li> <li>Company Voluntary Arrangements (CVAs)</li> <li>Independent business reviews</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong financial analysis and modelling skills with a solid understanding of financial statements.</li> <li>A track record of consistently delivering high-value work to meet client needs.</li> <li>Experience of supervising other professionals, acting as a positive role model and able to motivate others.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills, including giving clear direction to the team; jobs.title: Senior Q-commerce Operations Specialist
jobs.description: As the Quick Commerce Operations Specialist, you will be the bridge between commercial ambition and operational excellence for the ITSEE region. You will own the operational performance of our Q-Commerce business across the region. You will act as the regional engine for efficiency and optimizing how we pick, pack, and deliver. Whether it’s reducing cancellations, optimizing the cost of large orders, or launching in-store picker models, you will be the go-to expert driving the execution of initiatives that directly impact our P&L and customer experience. You will be on top of the regional performance, identify opportunities and unlock value by implementing region-wide initiatives across all quick commerce levers. ROLE RESPONSIIBLITIES Partner Operations HQ Project implementation: Lead the regional coordination of Partner Ops initiatives in strict alignment with global team initiatives (e.g. picker accounts, Wait for Assembly,...)  KPI Optimization: Act as the primary enabler for local teams to hit targets on key operational metrics, including IND (Item Not Delivered,  Cancellations, and Waiting Time)  Picking Excellence: Strategize and implement models to improve the overall execution of orders, finding commercially viable ways to improve order accuracy and speed. Big Order & Bundling Strategy: Implement specific initiatives to reduce the cost of "Big Orders" in line with global initiatives Cross-Functional Liaison: Bridge the gap between Q-Commerce needs and the core Supply Operations team to ensure the best outcomes Glovo Q-Commerce Analytical Framework & Performance Analytical Ownership: Design and own the QC analytical framework for the ITSEE region. You will be responsible for how we "view" the business operationally. Unified Reporting: Ensure a unified approach to evaluating business performance across all ITSEE markets, ensuring data consistency and transparency. Owner of key documents like MP and Superdocs.  Opportunity Mapping: Proactively identify operational bottlenecks through deep-dive data analysis and turn those insights into actionable improvement plans.  Best Practice Scaling: Act as the regional knowledge hub, ensuring that a win in one city or country is quickly shared and implemented across the entire ITSEE group.
